integrity: The proof is analytic. Exhaustive finite computation is included only as corroboration. The published Proposition 2.17 is compared by statement and by direct counterexample rather than treated as valid coverage.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the standard convention that complete multipartite graphs may have singleton partite classes. It does not concern total restrained coalitions or non-multipartite graph families.
title: Corrected restrained coalition number of complete multipartite graphs
